task.title: Avoid scheduling on GPU nodes unless needed using node affinity
task.shortdesc: Keep general workloads off specialized GPU nodes by expressing an explicit anti-affinity preference or requirement.

step.cmd: Identify how GPU nodes are labeled in your cluster (for example, "accelerator=nvidia" or a GPU pool label).
For general workloads, add a required rule that excludes GPU labels using "operator: DoesNotExist" or "NotIn".
Alternatively, add a preferred rule that de-prioritizes GPU nodes while still allowing fallback if necessary.
Apply the workload and confirm pods avoid GPU nodes by checking assigned nodes for GPU labels.
For GPU workloads, invert the rule to require the GPU label and validate placement on GPU-capable nodes.

result.p: Expected result after completing this task.
